transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi there! Yes, I do have a few questions. First off, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, including gardening, after 1 week. Try to avoid strenuous work or heavy lifting for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, that's good to know. Another question I have is: when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes again?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it's safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I'm very sensitive to bright light right now. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Some light sensitivity can be normal while the eye adjusts, and if it’s just mild and things seem brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses outside can help. But significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity especially if the eye is red and painful, is not normal and may need checking. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for that information. My last question is, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after surgery. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting more blurry, it may need checking. Do you have any more questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all for now. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all for now. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they've all been answered. Thank you again!
